WITH feb_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitId,
    totals.transactions as transactions,
    device.deviceCategory,
    visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
-- Sessions with transactions in Feb 2017
feb_transactions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM feb_sessions
  WHERE transactions IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get first transaction per visitor in Feb 2017 (earliest date, then earliest visitStartTime)
first_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_transaction_date,
    deviceCategory,
    visitStartTime as first_transaction_starttime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC, visitStartTime ASC) as rn
  FROM feb_transactions
),
-- Get first visit per visitor in Feb 2017
first_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM feb_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  ft.deviceCategory
FROM first_transactions ft
JOIN first_visits fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.rn = 1
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
),
all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, s.visitId, h.hitNumber, h.time, h.page.pagePath
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` sess
  JOIN sessions s ON sess.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId AND sess.visitId = s.visitId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(sess.hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, time, pagePath,
    LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS nextPagePath,
    LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM all_page_hits
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, time, pagePath, nextPagePath,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(next_time - time AS FLOAT64), 1000) AS time_spent_seconds
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE pagePath = '/home'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT nextPagePath FROM home_hits WHERE nextPagePath IS NOT NULL GROUP BY nextPagePath ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_next_page,
  CAST(MAX(time_spent_seconds) AS INT64) AS max_time_spent_seconds
FROM home_hits
WHERE nextPagePath IS NOT NULL

WITH action_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    h.eCommerceAction.action_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month, h.eCommerceAction.action_type
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%B %Y', month) AS month_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = '3' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END), 
              SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = '2' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS add_to_cart_conversion_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = '6' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END), 
              SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = '2' THEN event_count ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS purchase_conversion_rate
FROM action_counts
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
    AND visitNumber = 1
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) BETWEEN DATE('2016-08-01') AND DATE('2017-04-30')
),
new_users_with_long_initial AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
    AND visitNumber = 1
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) BETWEEN DATE('2016-08-01') AND DATE('2017-04-30')
    AND totals.timeOnSite > 300
),
users_with_subsequent_purchase AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions > 0
    AND visitNumber > 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_users) as total_new_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_users_with_long_initial nli
   INNER JOIN users_with_subsequent_purchase usp ON nli.fullVisitorId = usp.fullVisitorId) as qualifying_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_users_with_long_initial nli
     INNER JOIN users_with_subsequent_purchase usp ON nli.fullVisitorId = usp.fullVisitorId),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM new_users)
  ) * 100 as percentage

SELECT 
  provider_city,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS city_discharges,
  SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY city_discharges DESC

SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  ROUND(AVG(temp), 1) AS avg_temp,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)), 1) AS avg_wind_speed,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(prcp), 1), 2) AS precipitation
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64) AS year, temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(year AS INT64), temp, wdsp, prcp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020`
  WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

    SELECT year, month, day, latitude, longitude, wind_speed

    UNION ALL

    WHERE wind_speed IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL

    UNION ALL

GROUP BY year, month, day
ORDER BY avg_wind_speed DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date,
  temp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009`
WHERE stn = '723758'
  AND mo = '10'
  AND temp != 9999.9
ORDER BY temp DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Single row: day of week and hour with most trips from the top station in 2018
WITH top_station AS (
  SELECT start_station_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND start_station_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY start_station_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
day_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM starttime) as day_of_week, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
  GROUP BY day_of_week
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
hour_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_citibike.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2018
    AND starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND start_station_id = (SELECT start_station_id FROM top_station)
  GROUP BY hour_of_day
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.day_of_week, h.hour_of_day
FROM day_counts d, hour_counts h

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as matching_rows,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND)), COUNT(*) * 60.0) as avg_trip_duration_minutes,
  MIN(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) / 60.0) as min_minutes,
  MAX(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) / 60.0) as max_minutes,
  AVG(t.trip_distance) as avg_distance
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pu
  ON t.pickup_location_id = pu.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` do
  ON t.dropoff_location_id = do.zone_id
WHERE t.data_file_year = 2016
  AND t.data_file_month = 2
  AND DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-02-01' AND '2016-02-07'
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pu.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND do.borough = 'Brooklyn'

SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * 2 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((s_end.latitude - s_start.latitude) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2), 2) +
        COS(s_start.latitude * ACOS(-1) / 180) * COS(s_end.latitude * ACOS(-1) / 180) *
        POWER(SIN((s_end.longitude - s_start.longitude) * ACOS(-1) / 180 / 2), 2)
      )
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_start
  ON t.start_station_id = s_start.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` s_end
  ON t.end_station_id = s_end.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6
  UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
monthly_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM end_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS customer_minutes_thousands,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0 AS subscriber_minutes_thousands,
    ABS(
      SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END)
    ) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_minutes_thousands
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  am.month,
  COALESCE(md.abs_diff_minutes_thousands, 0) AS abs_diff_minutes_thousands
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN monthly_diffs md ON am.month = md.month
ORDER BY am.month

SELECT ROUND(MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom), t.duration_sec)), 1) as highest_avg_speed_mps
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s_start ON CAST(t.start_station_id AS STRING) = s_start.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s_end ON CAST(t.end_station_id AS STRING) = s_end.station_id
WHERE s_start.region_id = 14 
  AND s_end.region_id = 14
  AND ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom) > 1000

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS pop_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020 AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m 
  ON u.country_name = m.country_name AND m.year = 2020
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH us_data AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) AS anxiety,
    SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) AS depression,
    date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'
),
period_2019 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2019,
    AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2019
  FROM us_data
  WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01'
),
period_2020 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2020,
    AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2020
  FROM us_data
  WHERE date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  'United States' AS country,
  p2019.avg_anxiety_2019,
  p2019.avg_depression_2019,
  p2020.avg_anxiety_2020,
  p2020.avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2020.avg_anxiety_2020 - p2019.avg_anxiety_2019, p2019.avg_anxiety_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2020.avg_depression_2020 - p2019.avg_depression_2019, p2019.avg_depression_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_depression
FROM period_2019 p2019, period_2020 p2020

SELECT 
  season,
  round,
  days_from_epoch,
  game_date,
  day,
  win_seed,
  win_region,
  win_market,
  win_name,
  win_alias,
  win_pts,
  lose_seed,
  lose_region,
  lose_market,
  lose_name,
  lose_alias,
  lose_pts,
  num_ot,
  academic_year
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
  AND (win_market IN ('Memphis', 'South Florida', 'Missouri', 'UNLV', 'DePaul')
       OR lose_market IN ('Memphis', 'South Florida', 'Missouri', 'UNLV', 'DePaul'))
ORDER BY season, game_date, win_market, lose_market

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, MAX(evaluation_group_sequence_number) as max_eg_seq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` 
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code
),
filtered_pop AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM latest_eval l
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON l.state_code = p.state_code AND l.max_eg_seq = p.evaluation_group_sequence_number
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    fp.evaluation_group,
    fp.location_name as state_name,
    fp.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
    fp.expansion_factor,
    fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN filtered_pop fp
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = fp.plot_sequence_number AND c.state_code = fp.state_code
),
timberland_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    state_name,
    SUM(
      expansion_factor 
      * CASE 
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
          ELSE 1.0
        END
      * condition_proportion_unadjusted
    ) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
    AND reserved_status_code = 0
    AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group, state_name
  ORDER BY total_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
forestland_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    state_name,
    SUM(
      expansion_factor 
      * CASE 
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
          WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
          ELSE 1.0
        END
      * condition_proportion_unadjusted
    ) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group, state_name
  ORDER BY total_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'timberland' as category, CAST(t.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, CAST(t.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group, t.state_name, t.total_acres
FROM timberland_acres t
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forestland' as category, CAST(f.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, CAST(f.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group, f.state_name, f.total_acres
FROM forestland_acres f

WITH plot_tree_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT plot_sequence_number, plot_state_code, plot_inventory_year
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree`
),
pop_distinct AS (
    SELECT plot_sequence_number, expansion_factor, 
           adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 
           adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_sequence_number ORDER BY evaluation_sequence_number) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
    WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
plot_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        pti.plot_state_code as state_code,
        pti.plot_inventory_year as inventory_year,
        p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted as subplot_size,
        p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted as macroplot_size
    FROM plot_tree_info pti
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON pti.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    JOIN (SELECT * FROM pop_distinct WHERE rn = 1) p ON pti.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    WHERE c.condition_status_code = 1
      AND pti.plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
),
state_avg_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        inventory_year,
        AVG(subplot_size) as avg_subplot_size,
        AVG(macroplot_size) as avg_macroplot_size
    FROM plot_sizes
    GROUP BY state_code, inventory_year
),
subp_max AS (
    SELECT state_code, inventory_year, avg_subplot_size
    FROM state_avg_sizes
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_subplot_size DESC) = 1
),
macr_max AS (
    SELECT state_code, inventory_year, avg_macroplot_size
    FROM state_avg_sizes
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_macroplot_size DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 'subplot' as plot_type, s.inventory_year, CAST(s.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, s.avg_subplot_size as avg_size
FROM subp_max s
UNION ALL
SELECT 'macroplot' as plot_type, m.inventory_year, CAST(m.state_code AS STRING) as state_code, m.avg_macroplot_size as avg_size

-- For each accident in Jan-Aug 2015, count distinct persons and persons with injury_severity = 4
WITH accident_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.state_number,
        a.consecutive_number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) as distinct_persons,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN p.person_number END) as severe_injury_count
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p 
        ON a.state_number = p.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
    WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY a.state_number, a.consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_accidents_with_multiple_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_persons > 1 AND severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accidents_with_multiple_severe_injuries,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_persons > 1 AND severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN distinct_persons > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 as percentage
FROM accident_stats

WITH speed_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    AVG(ABS(CAST(travel_speed AS INT64) - CAST(speed_limit AS INT64))) AS avg_speed_diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999)
    AND speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
    AND travel_speed IS NOT NULL
    AND speed_limit IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
person_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) AS num_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fatalities
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
vehicle_primary AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    body_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE vehicle_number = 1
),
accident_base AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.consecutive_number,
    a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
    a.day_of_week,
    a.hour_of_crash,
    a.work_zone,
    v.body_type,
    pc.num_persons,
    pc.num_fatalities,
    sd.avg_speed_diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
  JOIN vehicle_primary v 
    ON a.state_number = v.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number
  JOIN person_counts pc
    ON a.state_number = pc.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = pc.consecutive_number
  LEFT JOIN speed_diff sd
    ON a.state_number = sd.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = sd.consecutive_number
  WHERE pc.num_persons > 1
)
SELECT 
  state_number,
  body_type,
  number_of_drunk_drivers,
  day_of_week,
  hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN work_zone != 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS work_zone_binary,
  CASE WHEN num_fatalities > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS label,
  CASE 
    WHEN avg_speed_diff IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END AS speed_diff_level
FROM accident_base
LIMIT 15

    q.owner_user_id as question_owner,
    q.accepted_answer_id,
    q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
),
answer_data AS (
  SELECT 
    a.id as answer_id,
    a.parent_id as question_id,
    a.owner_user_id as answer_owner,
    a.score as answer_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
),
total_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    SUM(answer_score) as total_score
  FROM answer_data
  GROUP BY question_id
),
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    ad.answer_id,
    ad.question_id,
    ad.answer_owner,
    ad.answer_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ad.question_id ORDER BY ad.answer_score DESC) as score_rank
  FROM answer_data ad
),
associated_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, question_owner as user_id
  FROM question_data
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT qd.question_id, ad.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM question_data qd
  JOIN answer_data ad ON ad.question_id = qd.question_id AND ad.answer_id = qd.accepted_answer_id
  WHERE ad.answer_owner IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT ad.question_id, ad.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM answer_data ad
  WHERE ad.answer_score > 5
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT ad.question_id, ad.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM answer_data ad
  JOIN total_scores ts ON ts.question_id = ad.question_id
  WHERE ad.answer_score > 0 AND ad.answer_score > 0.2 * ts.total_score
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT DISTINCT ra.question_id, ra.answer_owner as user_id
  FROM ranked_answers ra
  WHERE ra.score_rank <= 3
),
user_questions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, question_id
  FROM associated_users
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
),
user_view_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    uq.user_id,
    SUM(qd.view_count) as total_view_count
  FROM user_questions uq

WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.gene_symbol,
    r.sample_type_name,
    p.protein_abundance_log2ratio AS protein,
    LN(r.fpkm_unstranded + 1) AS expression
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a ON p.aliquot_id = a.aliquot_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r ON a.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode AND p.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
  WHERE r.primary_site = 'Kidney' 
    AND r.sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND p.protein_abundance_log2ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND r.fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
),
gene_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    gene_symbol,
    sample_type_name,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * expression) - SUM(protein) * SUM(expression)) 
    / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(protein * protein) - SUM(protein) * SUM(protein)) 
                  * (COUNT(*) * SUM(expression * expression) - SUM(expression) * SUM(expression))), 0) as correlation
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY gene_symbol, sample_type_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
  sample_type_name,
  ROUND(AVG(correlation), 6) as avg_correlation
FROM gene_corr
WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type_name
ORDER BY sample_type_name

-- Final result
WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
tas_entities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id, pe_st.pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe_st
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pe_st.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe_st.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  WHERE pe_st.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
all_uniprot_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uniprot_id FROM tas_entities
),
pathway_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.stable_id as pathway_stable_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN te.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN te.uniprot_id END) as targets_within,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN te.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN te.uniprot_id END) as non_targets_within
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pathway_stable_id FROM tas_entities) lp
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON lp.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  JOIN tas_entities te ON lp.pathway_stable_id = te.pathway_stable_id
  GROUP BY p.stable_id, p.name
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sorafenib_targets) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_uniprot_ids WHERE uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets)) as total_non_targets
),
with_chi AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.pathway_stable_id,
    ps.pathway_name,
    ps.targets_within,
    tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within as targets_outside,
    ps.non_targets_within,
    tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within as non_targets_outside,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      POWER(
        (ps.targets_within * (tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within)) - 
        ((tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within) * ps.non_targets_within), 2
      ) * (tc.total_targets + tc.total_non_targets),
      (ps.targets_within + (tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within)) * 
      (ps.non_targets_within + (tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within)) * 
      (ps.targets_within + ps.non_targets_within) * 
      ((tc.total_targets - ps.targets_within) + (tc.total_non_targets - ps.non_targets_within))
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
  pathway_stable_id,
  pathway_name,
  chi_squared,
  targets_within,
  targets_outside,
  non_targets_within,
  non_targets_outside
FROM with_chi
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH install_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(user_first_touch_timestamp) as install_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
    AND user_first_touch_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    AND DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) BETWEEN '2018-08-01' AND '2018-09-30'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
uninstall_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as uninstall_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_remove'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_status AS (
  SELECT 
    i.user_pseudo_id,
    i.install_ts,
    u.uninstall_ts,
    CASE 
      WHEN u.uninstall_ts IS NULL THEN 'never_uninstalled'
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(u.uninstall_ts), TIMESTAMP_MICROS(i.install_ts), DAY) <= 7 THEN 'uninstalled_within_7_days'
      ELSE 'uninstalled_after_7_days'
    END as status
  FROM install_users i
  LEFT JOIN uninstall_events u ON i.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('uninstalled_after_7_days', 'never_uninstalled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100, 2) as percentage_of_users
FROM user_status

-- Final retention analysis
WITH july_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180708'
),
users_with_earlier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20180701'
  AND e.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM july_users)
),
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id
  FROM july_users j
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users_with_earlier u WHERE u.user_pseudo_id = j.user_pseudo_id
  )
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_new_users FROM cohort_users
),
user_weekly_activity AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 0 as week_offset
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180708'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 1 as week_offset
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20180715'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 2 as week_offset
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180716' AND '20180722'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 3 as week_offset
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180723' AND '20180729'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 4 as week_offset
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180730' AND '20180805'
),
distinct_user_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uwa.user_pseudo_id, uwa.week_offset
  FROM user_weekly_activity uwa
  WHERE uwa.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM cohort_users)
),
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    week_offset,
    COUNT(*) as retained_users
  FROM distinct_user_weeks
  GROUP BY week_offset
)
SELECT 
  'Week ' || CAST(r.week_offset AS STRING) as week_identifier,
  cs.total_new_users as total_new_users,
  r.retained_users
FROM retention r
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
ORDER BY r.week_offset
